evidence_kind: Additive product-format and source-preservation contract; not native AU or DAW qualification
required: The product explicitly selects VST3 only before including the wrapper-generation helper, with no cache override enabling AU
The existing product format set still includes Standalone and preserves its Apple AU target
VST3 .cpp and .mm interface targets generate exactly one reviewed source of the original language and preserve unrelated sources and source order
The AU target keeps its exact interface-source paths, source order, include directories, compile definitions and link libraries
No original JUCE source byte is changed, no AU generated source is emitted, and AU sources are not added as generation dependencies
Unreviewed, missing or duplicated AU wrapper sources do not affect VST3-only configuration because AU must not be inspected or replaced
LF and CRLF inputs and repeated configurations generate identical VST3 content
Missing, duplicated or unreviewed selected VST3 sources fail closed
Empty and unsupported selected-format lists fail closed
The existing broader platform test and its acceptance JSON remain unchanged
mutation_contract: Remove the product's explicit VST3-only selector
Select AU as well as VST3 in the product
Ignore the product selector and generate both wrapper formats
Mutate an untouched AU interface property
limits: This gate adds exact source/build-system assertions only. It changes no numerical, curve, image, audio or native acceptance limits. Portable macOS source-shape tests do not establish a native macOS VST3 build, AU scheduling qualification or DAW/release approval.
